text: Friendly people from the first call to the final check. They fixed a dripping faucet the same week I reached out and left the kitchen spotless.
They had to come back a second time to finish the water heater swap, but everything works now.
Showed up on time, wore covers over their boots, and walked me through the shutoff valve before leaving. You can tell the crew takes pride in the work.
The plumber showed up almost an hour late and then rushed the install. Not what I paid for.
Wrong part put on the first visit, and by nightfall the new valve was leaking and the cabinet floor was a mess. Now the tap is broken too.
Crew left the basement dirty with dust everywhere and nobody came back to sweep it. Disappointing cleanup after a big job.
This is not getting resolved with another apology. My lawyer will be in touch about the damage from the failed fitting.
I was charged twice for the same service call, and I want a full refund today.
